metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 2001 · Jeepers Creepers
metas.description: A brother and sister driving home through isolated countryside for spring break encounter a flesh-eating creature which is in the midst of its ritualistic eating spree.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 2003 · Jeepers Creepers 2
metas.description: Set a few days after the original, a championship basketball team's bus is attacked by The Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror, on the last day of his 23-day feeding frenzy.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.9 · 2017 · Jeepers Creepers III
metas.description: Sheriff Dan Tashtego and a team of creeper hunters enlist the help of officer Davis Tubbs to help stop the monster's eating spree.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 2.6 · 2022 · Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
metas.description: Forced to travel with her boyfriend, Laine begins to experience premonitions associated with the urban myth of The Creeper. She believes that something supernatural has been summoned - and that she is at the center of it all.
